correctness.rationale: For each irrational b≥10 and every z∈R², the published Theorem B (finite graph capture) and Proposition 41 (on-graph dichotomy) imply finite eventual entry into exactly one of X_b,Q_b. Direct substitution verifies both 3-cycles. On each length-n polyhedral sign itinerary F_b^n(z)=Mz+u+bv with integer M,u,v. The Q_b first coordinates have nonintegral b-coefficients ±1/3 (with rational constants), so no rank-zero cell can map to Q_b for irrational b. A nonzero-rank affine cell has inverse image of a point in a proper affine subspace; itinerary boundaries are finitely many lines. Thus E_b=⋃_{n≥0}F_b^{-n}(Q_b) is planar-null and has dimension ≤1. The first-quadrant ray (s,s+(b+1)/3), s>0, maps to (-(b+4)/3,(2b-1)/3)∈Q_b, proving dim_H E_b=1. Since all positive-rank hits of X_b and cell boundaries are null, the interiors of rank-zero cells mapping into X_b give an open full-measure, hence dense, core of its basin. Finite symbolic check.py supplies branch-cycle base arithmetic only; no extrapolation of finite words.
